Update notice of Warriors of the Nile 2 at the end of October
notes.notes:
Dear warriors, 
Thank you for your support. 
How your battle on the Nile is going? 
Now, new storm is coming, the new enemies will appear on the Nile.

We plan to update the game at the end of October.
·Add a new BOSS to each chapter, and you will encounter new challenges.
·Add 3 special elite battles to Chapter 3.
·Add a new skin (designed for the champion to participate in the previous FastPass activity).
·Other content

At the same time, we will prepare new activities to enrich your experience outside the game.

Welcome to our discord: https://discord.gg/uykMdxD

notes.title: Version 0.8525
notes.notes:
Bug fixed:
- Fixed the bug that the completed [Hero Trials] icon was displayed incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that [Swift Steps] Tablets couldn’t take effect under certain circumstances. 
- Fixed the bug that specific mistakes would occur when [Spiny Shell] and [Beetle Guard III] co-existed.
- Fixed the bug that [Azure Sword] would do damage around the wrong targets.
- Fixed the bug that [Beetle Bravery] would execute incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the mistakes of the wrong pictures of General Charm [Wisdom].
- Fixed the bug that [Desert Guard] would execute incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that [Beetle Officer] would execute incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that some specific accessories would make wrong results when received.
- Fixed some mistakes in English and Japanese translation
- Adjusted the skill effect of the summonings in [Scorpion Elemental].
- Adjusted the accessories available in the talent list of [Scythe Wielder].

notes.title: Version 0.8520
notes.notes:
Bug fixed:
- Fixed the bug that caused the game to stuck when enemy summonings appeared under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that European players would get stuck in attacking when using Berserker.
- Fixed the problems caused by incorrect upgrade effects of player summonings under certain circumstances;
- Adjusted the stat and passive skills of [Imperial Warrior].
- Adjusted the effect of [Blade Pursuit] to prevent the program from being stuck under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that the forward path of [Phantom Claws] was incorrect under certain circumstances. 
- Fixed the bug that Icarus’s summonings could not restore energy to the character when they killed the enemies.
- Fixed the bug that [Star Blitz] could not take effects on specific enemy.
- Fixed the bug that the performance could not play correctly when [Moon Ritual] take effect in the second time.
- Fixed the bug that [Set Warscythe] could not increase attack damage under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that monster kill counts belonged to the wrong account when the battle was settled under certain circumstances
- Fixed some mistakes in description for several Tables and weapons.
- Fixed some mistakes in description for several Tables when translated into English.
